# A zero-arg computed function whose body calls an async native is lowered
# by the NoAsyncReactive pass.  The reactive read site is rewritten to a
# synchronous state-field access and an async kicker fires at startup.
#
# Calling greeting() from a visual prop triggers the hoist path, which
# synthesises __hoist_N (renamed from greeting) then lowers it:
#   - synthetic state field __async___hoist_0 (zero value "")
#   - async kicker $compute___hoist_0 that resolves the value
#   - synchronous wrapper __hoist_0 that reads the state field

sngl generate --lang=none --platform=html --out=out app.sngl
exists out/index.html

# Synthetic settled-state field for the lowered computed.
grep '__async___hoist_0' out/index.html

# Async kicker function that populates the settled-state field.
grep 'async function \$compute___hoist_0' out/index.html

# The kicker is called at startup so the initial value is fetched.
grep '\$compute___hoist_0()' out/index.html

# The original async call is awaited inside the kicker.
grep 'await fetchHello' out/index.html

-- app.sngl --
import . "sngl:std"
import api "js:./api"

func greeting() => api.fetchHello("world")

component main {
    text(value=greeting())
}

-- api/index.ts --
export async function fetchHello(name: string): Promise<string> { return "hi " + name; }
